market.label: Marketplace
market.description: Player market: list items for sale, buy from others.

command.description: Marketplace: buy and sell items between members.
command.sell: Put an item up for sale.

browse.title: 🏪 Marketplace
browse.intro: Pick a listing to buy one unit.
browse.empty: No listings yet. Be the first with `/auction sell`!

mine.title: 📦 My listings
mine.intro: Pick a listing to cancel it (items are returned to you).

buy.gone: ❌ This listing is no longer available.
buy.ownListing: ❌ You can't buy your own listing (use “My listings” to cancel it).

cancel.done: ↩️ Listing cancelled: {qty}× {emoji} **{name}** back in your inventory.

sell.done: 🏷️ Listed: {qty}× {emoji} **{name}** at {unit}/ea. See it with `/auction browse`.
sell.notTradable: ❌ {emoji} {name} isn't tradable, it can't be sold here.
sell.tooCheap: ❌ Price too low: minimum {min} per item.
sell.tooMany: ❌ You reached the active listing limit ({max}).

g0.description: Member-to-member market through /auction. Listing an item escrows it until it is bought or cancelled.

taxPercent.label: Server tax taken from the seller (0-100 %)
taxPercent.help: Share of the price taken from the SELLER on each sale, and removed from circulation. It is the only outflow for the currency: with no tax, the money supply only grows and prices follow.

maxListingsPerUser.label: Max active listings per member
maxListingsPerUser.help: How many active listings one member may hold. Stops a player cornering the market by listing their whole inventory at once.

minPrice.label: Absolute minimum unit price for a listing
minPrice.help: Absolute floor, in coins, whatever the item. Mostly there to forbid the 0-coin listings used to move items between accounts without it looking like a gift.

minPricePercent.label: Minimum price as a % of the item's shop price (0-100)
minPricePercent.help: A second floor, as a percentage of the item's SHOP price. The floor actually applied is the higher of the two. Without it, a rare item can be dumped at the price of a common one. 0 disables it.
